ai_summary: The funding supports the establishment of regional clinical networks to provide specialized diagnostic evaluations for difficult-to-diagnose conditions. Eligible applicants include Indian/Native American Tribal Governments, federal agencies, U.S. territories, faith-based organizations, and regional organizations, with a focus on regional partnerships.
ai_quote: provide a coordinated, multidisciplinary and participant-centered evaluation of individuals with highly challenging, difficult-to-diagnose conditions.
